eshold. The velocity v does not appear in the law.

I found it by searching small combinations of candidate terms with linear least squares. The best fits all reduced to √t and 1/x with those two coefficients. The other terms I tried (1/x², v, v², cos t and similar) came out near zero, around 1e-12.

best.code:
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    return params[0]*np.sqrt(t)+params[1]/x
